title: CodeRabbit product tour
description: Four capabilities, one control layer — from the pull request author's seat.

children.title: Introduction
children.description: Four capabilities, one control layer — and where the PR Author fits.

children.title: Reviewing local changes
children.description: Catch issues in your editor and from Claude Code, before you open a pull request.

children.title: Walkthroughs
children.description: A plain-English summary, a layered file walkthrough, an effort estimate, and a sequence diagram.

children.title: Pre-merge checks
children.description: Automated quality gates that block the merge until your rules pass.

children.title: The anatomy of a finding
children.description: Every finding explained — category, severity, static analysis, a repro script, and a fix. Even for Terraform.

children.title: Chat is your friend
children.description: Delegate to the bot — ask it to generate unit tests in their own pull request.

children.title: Learnings
children.description: Turn a review thread into durable, attributed rules your future reviews apply.

children.title: Issue validation
children.description: Check the change against its linked issue's acceptance criteria, and flag out-of-scope work.

children.title: Coding guidelines & standards
children.description: Enforce a shared standard from another repo, citing the exact rule you violated.

children.title: Avoiding cross-repo breaking changes
children.description: Follow the contract across repos and name the exact call site that breaks.

children.title: Summary
children.description: A recap of the review that rides with your code from editor to merge gate — and a look ahead to the reviewer's seat.
